scope: 239 unique raster images across design, marketing and archived concepts, deduplicated by SHA-256. Includes incidental gameplay captures and historical sheets. Excludes reference-message screenshots and the separate production assets subtree; not a frame-by-frame production sprite audit.
method: All inventory contact sheets visually screened; priority/current Sean sources inspected individually. Small incidental faces cannot establish precise likeness.
identity_rules: Bald adult, established forehead/eyes/nose/jaw and gray chin beard with soul patch; avoid generic full beard or moustache.
Normal mode: orange shirt, blue overalls, adult stocky proportions; no baby or Hard-mode anatomy.
Easy bonnet/pacifier and Hard muscular torn clothing are intentional separate modes; never mix them.
Use adult seated anatomy for photoreal ads, not enlarged gameplay/chibi proportions.
Preserve all originals; supersede by versioned corrections.

magazine_verification.page_11: Marketing confirmed uniform scaling, no stretch: source artwork causes proportion issue.
magazine_verification.page_9: Old horizontal Main Break art remains embedded; corrected geyser v2 not embedded.
